description: Three-layer evaluation rubrics for Simon's Stage 3 Adversarial Screening Layer (Advocate, Skeptic, and Judge on gemini-4-neon), derived 1:1 from the 5 shared dossier input skills, strict missing-field abstention, and golden verdict calibration bands.

rubrics.name: ScreeningPacket v1.0.0 Contract
rubrics.criteria: Final output is valid JSON matching ScreeningPacket v1.0.0 (contract_version='1.0.0', screening_model='gemini-4-neon', valid embedded dossier_snapshot) with no extra keys.

rubrics.name: Five Rubric Keys Present & Sum to Total Score
rubrics.criteria: judge_decision.rubric_scores contains exact keys identity_reachability, live_vocal_proof, early_window_depth, listener_pull_cosigns, and stage_momentum_whitespace (each integer 0..2 with max_score=2), and their sum equals judge_decision.total_score (0..10, max_score=10).

rubrics.name: Zero Hallucinated URLs Outside Dossier Snapshot
rubrics.criteria: Every URL cited in advocate_case, skeptic_case, and judge_decision appears verbatim inside dossier_snapshot. Zero fabricated or external ungrounded URLs.

rubrics.name: Zero System Telemetry Leak
rubrics.criteria: ScreeningPacket and Field News steps contain zero leaked interaction_id, environment_id, trace_id, or raw tool logs.

layers.name: Layer 2 · Shared Dossier Input Skills & Abstention

rubrics.name: Identity & Direct Reachability Accuracy
rubrics.criteria: Accurately evaluates identity_reachability from identity_and_contact (project_type, home_city, platform_urls, has_public_business_contact, and contact_route_type: bio_email/mgmt_email vs open_dm vs none).

levels.0: Misread contact_route_type or ignored unresolved identity/unreachable contact.
levels.1: Captured reachability directionally but missed platform graph or project_type nuance.
levels.2: Scored identity_reachability (0..2) accurately with concrete pros/cons grounded in identity_and_contact.

rubrics.name: Live Vocal Proof & Attribution Rigor
rubrics.criteria: Accurately evaluates live_vocal_proof from source_and_media_queue (verified vs uncertain attribution_status, oembed_live_embeddable status, and multi-clip live session proof vs single-clip or studio-only uploads).

levels.0: Treated uncertain or studio-only clips as verified multi-take live vocal proof.
levels.1: Noted clip count or attribution but missed single-clip vs multi-take live distinction.
levels.2: Scored live_vocal_proof (0..2) accurately, distinguishing verified multi-clip live sessions from single-clip or uncertain studio uploads.

rubrics.name: Early Window & Catalog Concentration Check
rubrics.criteria: Accurately evaluates early_window_depth from public_footprint (pre_dsp_underground / early_dsp_inflection vs established_streaming, released_tracks_count / Bandcamp depth, and top_release_view_share_pct >=80% single-clip concentration risk).

levels.0: Ignored footprint_regime or missed extreme single-clip view concentration (>=80%).
levels.1: Checked footprint_regime but overlooked catalog depth or top_release_view_share_pct.
levels.2: Scored early_window_depth (0..2) accurately, weighing discovery window, release depth, and top_release_view_share_pct.

rubrics.name: Listener Pull & Peer Co-Sign Forensics
rubrics.criteria: Accurately evaluates listener_pull_cosigns from comment_forensics (release_requests + live_show_requests + genuine_praise share vs jokes_or_spam, plus notable_commenters co-signs).

levels.0: Ignored spam-heavy comments (>=50%) or fabricated audience demand.
levels.1: Cited comment counts broadly without separating high-intent requests or notable_commenters.
levels.2: Scored listener_pull_cosigns (0..2) accurately using intent ratios, spam share, and notable_commenters.

rubrics.name: Stage Momentum & Unsigned Whitespace
rubrics.criteria: Accurately evaluates stage_momentum_whitespace from live_history_and_credits (show_history, upcoming_shows, highest_venue_cap_observed, collaborator_credits, and unsigned A&R whitespace vs major-label lockup in public_team_mentions.label).

levels.0: Missed a major-label signing dealbreaker or misread show_history / team mentions.
levels.1: Checked show_history or label status partially without integrating venue cap and credits.
levels.2: Scored stage_momentum_whitespace (0..2) accurately across live momentum, credits, and unsigned A&R whitespace.

rubrics.name: Honest Missing-Fields Abstention
rubrics.criteria: Treats entries in dossier_snapshot.missing_fields as unverified unknowns surfaced in skeptic_case.missing_evidence_flags[] rather than inventing negative facts or fabricated failures.

levels.0: Turned missing_fields (e.g., unindexed show history) into fabricated negative claims (e.g., 'failed tour').
levels.1: Abstained from fabrication in rationale but omitted missing items from missing_evidence_flags[].
levels.2: Surfaced missing_fields cleanly in missing_evidence_flags[] and treated them strictly as unknowns rather than invented flaws.

rubrics.name: Advocate Concrete Upside Steelman
rubrics.criteria: advocate_case steelmans the strongest factual upside in dossier_snapshot with skill-tagged pros[] and a concrete standout_hook, without exaggerating or inventing ungrounded claims.

levels.0: Generic boilerplate praise or fabricated upside claims.
levels.1: Valid pros[] listed but vague headline or generic standout_hook.
levels.2: Sharp, grounded steelman headline, skill-attributed pros[], and concrete standout_hook anchored in dossier facts.

rubrics.name: Skeptic Real Risk, Concentration & Dealbreaker Audit
rubrics.criteria: skeptic_case surfaces substantive risks (view concentration, single-clip evidence, uncertain attribution, contact friction, major-label lockup), populates missing_evidence_flags[], and logs dealbreakers_checked[].

levels.0: Missed critical risks/dealbreakers or invented ungrounded criticisms.
levels.1: Listed cons[] partially or left dealbreakers_checked[] incomplete.
levels.2: Surfaced real dossier risks, concentration/contact gaps, missing_evidence_flags[], and explicit dealbreakers_checked[].

rubrics.name: Judge Synthesis & Golden Band Calibration
rubrics.criteria: judge_decision weighs both Advocate and Skeptic arguments fairly in rationale, sets calibrated confidence (0..1), and aligns verdict with golden score bands (total_score >= 7 -> 'elevate', 4..6 -> 'watch', <= 3 -> 'pass', unless overridden by an explicit hard dealbreaker).

levels.0: One-sided rationale ignoring Advocate/Skeptic tension or verdict contradicting golden score bands without a hard dealbreaker.
levels.1: Verdict matches score band, but rationale fails to explain how Advocate vs. Skeptic trade-offs were resolved.
levels.2: Balanced synthesis resolving Advocate vs. Skeptic tension, calibrated confidence, and strict alignment with golden bands (>=7 elevate, 4..6 watch, <=3 pass unless hard dealbreaker).
